name: Renseikan Kyudojo
tagline: Traditional Japanese archery in San Jose, California
description: Renseikan Kyudojo teaches kyudo, traditional Japanese archery, in San Jose, California. Classes Sundays 4:00–6:00 pm. New students are always welcome: walk in and observe, or take a free trial lesson.
policy: New students are always welcome. No uniform or equipment is required. No prior experience needed. New students should just walk in and observe class or take a free trial lesson at any time without making online appointments first.
